description: Draft fixes for a site or repo owner to review, each tied to its sources. kind `agents-md`: an AGENTS.md (setup, commands, layout, conventions) for a GitHub repo or docs site, every line citing its file and line. `jsonld`: WebSite/Organization/Product/SoftwareApplication JSON-LD built only from facts on the site. `alt-text`: alt text for images missing it, from image descriptions. `answers`: per H2 section, a question-shaped heading and an answer-first sentence drawn only from that section. Drafts never contain URLs, commands or numbers not in the sources. Cached 24h; counts as a new link.

fresh.description: Ignore the 24h cache and regenerate. Default false.

url.description: Any public http(s) link, e.g. "docs.stripe.com/payments", "github.com/honojs/hono", a PDF or a video URL. The scheme is optional.

name: generate_draft
title: Draft AGENTS.md, JSON-LD, alt text or answer-first headings
